concerns.text: The plan’s Feature Engineering phase lists descriptor generation (FR‑002, FR‑012) but does not explicitly state that the computed descriptors will be standardized (zero‑mean, unit‑variance) before model training, as required by FR‑012 in the spec and implied by the data‑model (which expects raw values and a separate scaler artefact). Add a clear step (e.g., “Standardize descriptors using the training‑set scaler before training”) to ensure consistency with the specification and data model.
